verdicts.proof: Old ride_card.dart:47-56 and ride_trip_card.dart:63-64,104-107 show the phase badge when the local recorder holds this ride (rec.recording && rec.rideId == ride.id) EVEN IF the server flag is false, else the server flag. v2 ride_card_v2.dart:39,73 and ride_trip_card_v2.dart:45,70 render RideLiveBadgeV2 only when ride.isRecording (server is_recording, ride_model.dart:404). Nothing overlays the local recorder on the list (myRidesProvider is invalidated only on stop/clear, ride_recorder_server.dart:432, ride_recorder_offline.dart:41). Path: phone records for a long time offline / server closed the ride (close_stale_user_rides) or list loaded with stale flag -> old card still shows 'Nahrávám/Pozastaveno', v2 card shows no badge and no red border. Normal case (server flag true) is equal or better (phase-aware badge).
verdicts.fix_idea: In RideCardV2 / RideTripCardV2 compute live = ride.isRecording || (rec.recording && rec.rideId == ride.id) (trip: any ride id) by watching rideRecorderProvider, as the old cards do.

verdicts.proof: Rule is in the notifier: ride_recorder.dart:297-300 (_start -> _ensurePreciseOnIos false -> _startFail = imprecise) and ride_recorder_pause.dart:250 for resume. Every v2 start goes through toggleManualRide (ride_actions.dart:37-44 -> showRideStartResultV2): dock CTA record_dock_v2.dart:94, selection record disc :146, recorder screen recorder_screen_v2.dart:77, Home row home_record_row_v2.dart:116; add menu community_submit.dart:135-138 -> _startResultV2. Resume: rideTogglePauseV2 (ride_pause_actions_v2.dart, n.resume() then showRideStartResultV2) from dock, live bar, Home disc, recorder, pause sheet, nav chip (route_nav_skin_v2.dart:99). ride_results_v2.dart:70-78 shows a warn sheet with heading v2UxRrPreciseT 'Zapni přesnou polohu' + Open settings (old was a snackbar).

Rollback logic is shared (ride_recorder.dart:317-331, failed -> RideStartResult.failed) and every v2 start entry (record_dock_v2.dart:94,146; recorder_screen_v2.dart:77; home_record_row_v2.dart:116; community_submit.dart:135-138) shows ride_results_v2.dart:79-85 with heading 'Záznam se nespustil' + retry. BUT the explanation is wrong: old eoRideStartFailed = 'Záznam se nepodařilo založit – nejspíš chybí internet. Zkus to znovu, až budeš mít signál.'; v2 v2UxRrFailW (translations_ext_60_v2_ux_routes_rides_a.dart:19) = 'Něco se pokazilo v telefonu. Zkus to znovu; když to nepůjde, restartuj appku.' The customer offline is told the phone is broken and to restart the app instead of 'no internet, wait for signal'.
verdicts.fix_idea: In ride_results_v2.dart RideStartResult.failed use why: tr.tr('eoRideStartFailed') (or reword v2UxRrFailW in all languages to the internet/signal reason).

verdicts.proof: Ordering check is in startManualResult (ride_recorder.dart:231-237) which every v2 start entry reaches via toggleManualRide / community _toggleManualRide (same list as G-1040), so a new ride is never started while the previous stop is unsaved. The block holds, but the v2 message for this case is the same 'failed' sheet whose text (v2UxRrFailW) blames the phone and advises restarting the app, while the real cause is the missing connection for the previous ride's save; old text said 'nejspíš chybí internet … až budeš mít signál'.
verdicts.fix_idea: Same as G-1040: use the internet/signal wording (eoRideStartFailed) as the why of the failed sheet.
